WITH major_counts AS (
  SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members
  FROM major_counts
)
SELECT major_counts.link_to_major, major_counts.member_count,
       CAST(major_counts.member_count AS REAL) / total.total_members
FROM major_counts
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 10
